description:
An exceptional opportunity awaits a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead a premier health and rehabilitation center. This confidential role offers a competitive annual salary range of $115,000 - $145,000, reflecting the importance of this leadership position within a facility committed to excellence in patient care and operational efficiency. We are seeking a visionary leader who can inspire staff, optimize performance, and ensure the highest standards of service delivery.

As the LNHA, you will be responsible for the overall management and success of the facility, overseeing all aspects of operations, financial performance, and regulatory compliance. This role is ideal for a professional who thrives in a dynamic environment and is passionate about making a significant impact on the lives of residents and the professional growth of their team. Join a facility dedicated to fostering a supportive and high-quality care environment.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in the state of Maryland.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in a leadership role within a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility.
Demonstrated knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care.
Proven ability to manage budgets, operations, and staff effectively.
Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $115,000 - $145,000 based on experience.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced MDS Coordinator (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Missouri Valley, IA. This vital role involves managing the Minimum Data Set (MDS) process to ensure accurate resident assessments and care planning, contributing significantly to the quality of care provided.

As an MDS Coordinator, you will play a crucial part in our interdisciplinary team, ensuring compliance with all federal and state regulations related to the Resident Assessment Instrument (RAI) process. We are looking for a professional who is passionate about resident well-being and committed to maintaining high standards of documentation and care coordination. This is a full-time opportunity offering competitive compensation.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa
Minimum of 1-2 years of experience as an MDS Coordinator
Strong knowledge of MDS 3.0 and the Resident Assessment Instrument (RAI) process
